about_the_game:
What if the Royal playing cards had a kingdom?
What if there was more than just a Jack, Queen, and King?
What if these Royals had to defend themselves from invaders?

Gameplay
In Luxuriant, a deck-building high strategy roguelike, you assemble a deck of Royals, Citizens, Weapons, and Resources, then fight through your Kingdoms Districts that are being actively invaded!  Each battle will chip away your deck as you store up Jewels to recruit more Citizens and Royals to the fray. Victory is determined by cumulative Points, and every decision, from which Royals to promote to which Weapons to Use WILL tip the balance between triumph and defeat.  The last boss is not a duck.

Key Features:

  • 30+ hours of gameplay!

  • 25+ Royal Cards with unique abilities!

  • 25+ Citizen Cards with unique abilities!

  • 20+ Weapon Cards including!

  • 160+ Enemy Cards! Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythic rarities!

  • 30 Levels!!

  • 25+ Status Effects with unique visual designs!

  • 10+ Enemy Effects with custom combat mechanics!

  • 8 Unique Card Suits!

  • 70+ Unlockable Cards!!

  • 4,000,000,000+ Seeds!

  • 35+ Steam Achievements!

  • 3 Save Slots!! (Cloud Saving too!)

  • 5 Bosses with Unique Transformations!

  • Secret Royal Cards!

  • 3 Booster Packs!

  • BOON CARDS

  • Multiple Tutorials

  • Roguelike Progression Loops!

  • Upgrade & Unlock Shops including Forging Cards, Awakening Weapons, and Enchanting Royals!

  • Dynamic Weather

  • Day/Night Cycle

  • Progressive sound engine using layered mechanics

  • AND MORE.....

short_description: Luxuriant is a fantasy card-driven roguelike deck-builder where you assemble and manage a deck of Royals, Citizens, Weapons, and Resources to outmaneuver Enemies in turn-based combat, earn Influence, progress through evolving levels, and unlock new cards for future runs.
